$note: Project config for scripts/conductor.mjs. Everything project-specific lives here — including the board's own location (boardPath) — so the conductor script is reusable across repos unchanged. Absent keys fall back to built-in defaults.

validators.$note: gate[] = reliable/objective validators, run diff-scoped as HARD gates. advisory[] = grep-heuristic validators (noisy on TS: magic-numbers-in-comments, bogus-unreachable) — their findings ANCHOR the LLM review instead of blocking, matching the source system's 'script floor + agent verified pass' design. Promote a validator to gate[] once red-fixture-calibrated. repoWide[] (W10-49): findings from these are NOT filtered to the ticket diff. Only honest while the validator reports ZERO repo-wide — then any finding is necessarily something this ticket introduced. validate-file-size hit zero at W10-48 (six over-cap files cleared across W10-46/47/48); if that count ever goes non-zero again, every ticket fails for debt it did not create, so remove the entry rather than waiving it.
